title: Vedic Trimshamsa D30, Shashtiamsa D60 and systematic Varga extension core

claims.RC-0102: D30 is calculated with the classical unequal five-span odd/even Rashi mapping rather than an incorrect equal thirty-slice shortcut.
claims.RC-0103: D60 resolves sixty 0.5-degree portions and exposes the disputed sign-mapping convention explicitly, defaulting to count-from-natal-Rashi without silently erasing the alternative reading.
claims.RC-0104: Additional equal, zodiacally advancing Varga definitions can be added through a validated twelve-Rashi start-map definition while retaining the common provenance and fail-closed calculation path.

non_claims: No claim is made here that D60 deity-name interpretation is complete.
No arbitrary Varga definition is treated as classical without separate source evidence and regression coverage.
No claim is made here for rendered UI, interpretation/editorial data, entitlement, independent Varga golden/reference evidence, device evidence or release readiness.
